### UI accessibility checklist
_If your PR includes UI changes, please utilize this checklist:_
- [ ] Semantic HTML implemented?
- [ ] Keyboard operability supported?

### Developer's checklist
_As a developer, please utilize this checklist:_
- [ ] Self reviewed the PR.
- [ ] No unnecessary comments left behind.
- [ ] End of File for all files.
- [ ] Commit messages are clear.
- [ ] Added documentation wherever necessary.
- [ ] Checked for impact ?

### Reviewer's checklist
_As a reviewer of the PR, please utilize this checklist:_

- [ ] Checked ticket status.
- [ ] Made sure all code practices are being followed.
- [ ] Checked for impact ?
